answer: Time-Bonded Identity. 1) Register with a unique vertex. 2) Pay 0.01 ETH for 30-day validity. 3) Renewals cost (N 0.001 ETH), where N is the renewal count. Total cost for N identities, each renewed once, is ~$10 x N$. Failure occurs if computational power allows mass renewal before expiry. This is like a wharf where each ship docking pays escalating fees, as the onyx represents the unforgeable digital proof of identity.
